$comment: Community skills MNDX installs from the open skills ecosystem (https://skills.sh) via `npx skills`, globally for Claude Code. Chosen per production concern for fit, install count and publisher trust, and read before inclusion (reviewed 2026-10-07). Which concerns use which skills: config/concerns.json. MNDX rules always override these skills (no push/deploy/commit/approval outside the pipeline). Install/update: /mndx:skills.
